events.name: Worcester Railers vs. Norfolk Admirals - Sharks Night
events.info: The Railers will take the ice in specialty Sharks jerseys inspired by the Worcester Sharks. Following the game, the jerseys will be auctioned off, with all proceeds benefiting the Shine Initiative and its mission to promote mental health awareness and support throughout the community. Making a special return for the evening is fan-favorite mascot Finz! Sharks fans will once again have the opportunity to see Finz in action as he joins in on the fun and helps bring back memories from the Sharks era. Exclusive Sharks merchandise will be available throughout the night, giving fans the chance to take home limited-edition apparel and collectibles! Fans in attendance will also receive a special Sharks-themed giveaway, available only on January 30. The giveaway will be distributed while supplies last, with a limit of one item per ticket.

events.name: Worcester Railers vs. Allen Americans - Pink in the Rink
events.info: We're turning the DCU Center Pink! We will be playing on pink ice, and will wear specialty Pink in the Rink jerseys during the game, which will be auctioned off for fans to bid on! All proceeds from the jersey auction will benefit the Cup Crusaders and their mission to support those impacted by breast cancer throughout the community. Fans will also have the opportunity to spend time with members of the Cup Crusaders throughout the evening. Special activations on the concourse will include the chance to get your hair spray painted pink and participate in other fun experiences that help raise awareness and show support for the cause. Throughout the game, fans will be able to honor friends, family members, and loved ones who have been impacted by breast cancer through special in-game tributes. These heartfelt recognitions will serve as a reminder that no one fights alone and that our community stands together in support.
